basePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: fantasy RPG dialogue portrait, initial character art exploration for The Laughing Stranger.
Primary request: ONE square painterly portrait of a mysterious male trickster god disguised as a human traveller, warm knowing amusement expression.
Subject: ageless adult man who appears about forty, lean angular face, expressive dark eyebrows, grey-green eyes, wavy dark shoulder-length hair with a subtle silver streak at one temple, light stubble. Worn charcoal travelling cloak over a simple muted wine-coloured medieval tunic, small plain brass cloak clasp. Believable, charming, quietly uncanny, never a clown or jester. He sits at a roadside milestone beneath a bare winter tree on the road to a medieval court. A single old coin rests between the fingers of his right hand at the lower edge.
Composition: square 1024x1024, chest-up, centered, face large and readable at small dialogue-card size, eyes directed toward viewer, slight three-quarter shoulders. Entire head and hair visible with breathing room.
Style: refined hand-painted fantasy book illustration, restrained visible brushwork, natural anatomy, crisp expressive face with softly painted peripheral detail. Muted winter background, weathered fabric, warm subtle light on face against cool background.
Expression: relaxed eyebrows, amused attentive eyes, small asymmetric welcoming smile; he knows your name before you introduce yourself.
Constraints: one character, one portrait, no panels, no typography, no frame, no watermark, no glowing eyes, no crown, no horns, no theatrical costume. This portrait will be the identity reference for future emotional variants.
delightedPrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: square fantasy RPG dialogue character portrait, delighted expression and pose variant.
Reference: supplied portrait establishes the exact identity, costume, setting and rendering style of The Laughing Stranger.
Create ONE new portrait of this SAME man in a distinctly different pose: he leans back slightly with spontaneous delighted laughter, head tilted slightly back and to one side, shoulders relaxed and opened up. His right hand raises the old coin beside his shoulder, pinched naturally between thumb and index finger; his left hand opens palm-up near his chest in a conspiratorial "now that is interesting" gesture. Broad natural laughing smile, happy eyes still engaged with the viewer. He delights in the player's audacious scheme.
Preserve same face and age, grey-green eyes, dark wavy hair and silver temple streak, stubble, charcoal travelling cloak, brass clasp, muted wine tunic. Keep same winter roadside tree, milestone and distant castle, same light, realistic painterly fantasy rendering and square chest-up camera framing. Pose change must be obvious in silhouette, while the head stays fully in frame and at similar scale for a dialogue UI. Anatomically sound hands. No text, no panels, no border, no glow or effects.
poseVariants: He sits bolt upright, shoulders squared, head level and chin slightly lowered. His right hand has closed around the coin into a relaxed but unmistakably still fist, resting against his sternum; the coin is concealed inside that hand. His other arm folds across his torso supporting that elbow. His mouth holds a tight thin asymmetric smile, but his eyes have lost all warmth and study the viewer beneath slightly lowered brows. A polite warning with an edge. Clearly change the silhouette and arm position from the reference.

He leans markedly forward toward the viewer, shoulders pitched forward, both forearms braced on his knees at the bottom of the image, hands mostly below frame, coin put away. Head slightly lowered, eyes looking directly at the viewer from beneath drawn brows. Smile entirely gone: firmly closed stern mouth, taut jaw, intense cold commanding stare. Quiet divine anger and absolute authority, never screaming or baring teeth. Pose is confrontational and visibly different in silhouette from the relaxed reference.
note: Concept portraits only; Jev emotion selection and UI integration are not implemented.
